reason: The job is the post-tenancy clean, waste removal and garden clearance at 18 Thistlevaunt Lane, with Brindlewick's £665 quote (event-006, property-preparation-quotation.pdf). Property, provider and amount match the job. The reference differs between the two PDFs (NBL-015-INSPECTION and NBL-015-Q1), but they are different document types, so I did not treat that as a mismatch. The landlord's approval (event-008, event-010) is conditional on recovering the cost from the former tenants' bond. That is a deposit matter, which policy says we never act on or decide, and the code flagged it (event-012, legal red flag). Event-009 told the contractor the quote was approved without that condition. Event-016 ("approved quote") does not say which quote it means. Event-007 also described the work only generally. The contractor is on hold (event-012, event-015), and the work depends on separate major maintenance with no completion date (event-018, event-020, event-021). A new tenant wants to move in on 28 September, so there is time pressure but no safety hazard, hence P2. A routine INSTRUCT_PROVIDER is not safe because the approval is ambiguous and conditional. Waiting or chasing is not suitable because the deposit topic cannot be waited on, and the blocker is a person's judgement. A person should confirm the landlord's approval and the bond condition, and sort out the maintenance sequencing. Nothing in the case tried to change my process.
